system_prompt:
You are a fourth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: four angles varied in size and labeled P, Q, R, and S from left to right.]

In which of the following are the angles ordered by size, from least to greatest?

Figure, described in words:
Four angles are shown side by side, labeled from left to right as P, Q, R, and S. Each angle has a horizontal ray pointing to the right, a second ray extending from the left endpoint, and a curved arc indicating the angle between the two rays:
- Angle P is an acute angle opening upward and to the right at approximately 45°.
- Angle Q is an obtuse angle opening upward and to the left at approximately 120°.
- Angle R is a right angle (90°) formed with a vertical ray extending straight up.
- Angle S is an acute angle opening upward and to the right at approximately 30°, smaller than angle P.

A. Q, P, R, S
B. Q, R, P, S
C. S, P, R, Q
D. S, R, P, Q

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
